description: Self-contained contenteditable heading (H1 / H2 / H3). Owns its JS keyboard-handler lifecycle. Renders the correct semantic element based on Level. Supports optional toggle (collapse/expand) controlled by IsToggleable. [JSInvokable] method names must match strings called in notion-editor.js — hence EventCallback parameter names differ to avoid C# naming conflicts.

parameters.name: OnContentSaved
parameters.description: Fired on blur when HTML content changed. Arg = new HTML.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Fired when Backspace is pressed on an empty block.

parameters.name: OnEnterSplit
parameters.description: Fired when Enter is pressed; creates a new Paragraph, not another heading. Arg = HTML fragment after the caret (may be empty).

parameters.name: OnMergeWithPrevious
parameters.description: Raised when Backspace is pressed at the start of a non-empty block. The payload is the block's current, sanitized HTML, which the previous block absorbs before this one is deleted.

parameters.name: OnStructuredPaste
parameters.description: Raised when pasted HTML carries more than one block element. The payload is the raw clipboard HTML; the consumer turns it into page blocks.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when the element receives focus.

parameters.name: OnIndentChange
parameters.description: Fired when Tab / Shift+Tab. Bool = shiftKey.

parameters.name: OnMentionMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '@' mention is triggered. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnPageLinkMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '[[' page-link is triggered. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnSlashMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '/' slash command is triggered. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnToggleChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the toggle arrow is clicked. Bool = new isOpen state.

parameters.name: OnTokenMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '{{' token syntax is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTypeConvert
parameters.description: Fired when a markdown shortcut is recognised (e.g. "heading1", "heading2").
